ratnik_emr_camo.notes: EMR ("tsifra") summer: light grey-green ground with dark-green, brown and black pixel clusters forming larger deforming blobs (Flecktarn-like micro/macro structure). Proportions used: ground ~45%, green 28%, brown 27% (black ~9% inside the dark clusters).

mm14_camo.notes: MM-14: five-tone digital pattern (light beige, light green, swamp green, grey-green, dark grey); slightly horizontally elongated shapes.

multicam.notes: UA plate carriers / helmet covers / some tops; organic 6-tone pattern, procedural approximation.

6b46_plate_carrier.notes: Ratnik lightweight plate carrier: front/back plate bags (Granit-type plates), cummerbund, padded shoulder straps, MOLLE, drag handle. Modelled: plate bags ~300 x 336 mm front / 310 x 344 mm back, 22-26 mm thick with plate bulge and shooter's-cut corners; cummerbund 180 mm; 6Sh117-style pouches: 3 flapped double AK mag pouches (85x155x62 mm, Fastex), radio pouch (R-187 style radio + antenna), grenade pouches, IFAK, hydration and dump pouch.

ua_plate_carrier.notes: JPC-style: slimmer plate bags (280 x 316 mm), integrated open-top triple mag shingle with visible AK mag bases, admin pouch with UA flag patch, CAT tourniquet, radio on the cummerbund, IFAK, grenade pouch; MultiCam + coyote webbing.

assault_kit.RU: 6B45 in assault configuration: shoulder/upper-arm protectors, groin protector, side plates, neck collar; 6B47 with NVG mount + headset or Altyn-style heavy visorless helmet; balaclavas on some; grenade pouches + 6Sh117 assault pouches, IFAK, dump pouch; knee + elbow pads, assault pack with radio, gloves

weapons.ak74m: AK-74M 943 mm, black polymer furniture, side-folding solid stock, 5.45 mm 30-rd curved mag (separate `magazine` node), two-chamber muzzle brake

skeleton.rig: MakeHuman cmu_mb (CMU-BVH compatible names); joint nodes carry identity rest rotations (world-aligned frames); skins use inverse bind = translate(-joint).

sockets.weapon_socket: child of RightHand: parent a weapon GLB (origin = pistol grip, +Z muzzle) with identity transform; matches all rifle-hold clips
sockets.weapon_socket_L: child of LeftHand: rifle carried by the handguard (grip_L in the palm) - use during throw_grenade
sockets.weapon_socket_back: child of Spine1: slung rifle diagonally on the back, muzzle up over the right shoulder (RPG gunner, drag_wounded, wounded clips)
sockets.mag_socket_L: child of LeftHand: attach ak74m `magazine` node during reloads
sockets.aim: child of Head at the eye midpoint (eye height)
sockets.aim_eye_R: child of Head at the right eye (sighting eye)
sockets.drag_handle: child of Spine1 at the vest drag handle (top of the back plate): contact point of being_dragged / drag_wounded

soldier_ru.notes: body_A/B/C are alternative variants (one visible at a time; A default). hands vs gloves are alternatives. helmet_A/helmet_B alternatives. backpack, legband_L, kneepads, pouches_back off by default. Gear is skinned to the shared skeleton (vest/pouches to Hips..Spine1/clavicles, helmet rigid to Head, kneepads rigid to *Leg, tape bands follow the sleeve weights). Vertex colours (COLOR_0) on gear carry baked ambient occlusion.
soldier_ru.combo_notes: Pre-combined presets for rendering (2 draw calls per soldier): `<name>` = ONE SkinnedMesh / ONE primitive with material soldier_atlas_ru (2048^2 atlas: base colour JPEG, normal PNG, ORM PNG [R=AO 1, G=roughness, B=metalness]) merging every visible part (body/head/eyes, hands or gloves, boots, vest, pouches, helmet, backpack, kneepads, assault armour, headset, balaclava); `<name>_tape` = the preset's arm/leg bands with the recolourable `tape` material; `<name>_LOD1` / `<name>_tape_LOD1` ~28% / ~40%. Same skeleton/skin as the per-part nodes, so all sockets keep working. extras.combo = true, hidden by default (show exactly one preset + its _tape and hide all per-part nodes). Camouflage is identical to the per-part materials: the uniform is copied texel-for-texel (90-degree turns only) at ~1.0 mm/texel (EMR / MM-14 pixels stay 3.5-6 texels wide), tiling gear camo is mapped into one wrap-padded repeat region per material at the same pattern scale (gear triangles never cross a repeat: components are shifted by whole tiles), vertex colours keep the baked AO. Balaclava presets drop the covered face triangles.
soldier_ru.tape_alt_material: tape (white #e9e9e4); for red tape set tape colour to #b01e1e (tape_red); materials named `tape` are recolourable

soldier_anims.contents: skeleton + sockets + clips only (no meshes); tracks: Hips translation + rotation of all 31 joints, 30 fps, linear
soldier_anims.in_place: loops have horizontal root motion stripped (Hips keeps vertical bob); deaths and dismount_jump keep root motion and end at rest
soldier_anims.time_scaling: ground_speed_mps is the clip's natural speed; the game time-scales (walk ~2.0, run ~5.0, crouch ~1.5 m/s). walk_rifle is a 2.1 m/s brisk walk (CMU 07_12) and run_rifle a 3.6 m/s fast run with a 17 deg combat lean (CMU 09_11) so the scaled cadence stays plausible (x1.0 / x1.4).

launchers.socket: weapon_socket (identity) for both rpg22.glb and rpg7.glb in aim_launcher / aim_launcher_kneel / fire_launcher
launchers.authored_for: RPG-22: right eye on the rear-sight line, tube underside on the right trapezius, right hand on the tube under the firing housing (= launcher origin), left palm under the front tube (rpg22 grip_L).

rpg7_offset.note: RPG-7 also fits with identity: its tube axis is 7 mm higher and its PGO-7 eyepiece sits 5 cm left / 4 cm below the eye (head over the tube instead of beside it). For an exact PGO-7 sight picture offset the launcher by [-0.051, 0.042, 0.0] (launcher local), at the cost of a 4 cm gap above the shoulder.

riding.frame: ride_sit_edge / ride_sit_deck / ride_aim: root = ride_seat_N empty (point on the sitting surface under the pelvis), +Z = seat facing; Hips joint 0.118 m above and 0.035 m behind the seat point; place the soldier root exactly on the seat empty (position + heading), no ground snapping.
riding.edge: thighs along +Z, knees ~0.42 m out, shins angled ~30 deg outward (clears the BTR's sloped upper hull), rifle across the lap
riding.deck: knees up, feet flat on the deck ~0.47 m ahead, rifle upright between the knees, butt on the deck
riding.dismount_jump: root on the ground at the landing point; the clip starts with the seat point at (0, 1.8, -1.6) relative to it (game: landing = seat + 1.6 m outward, seat ~1.8 m high); vertical and horizontal root motion kept; touchdown 0.84 s

medical.drag: drag_wounded (dragger) and being_dragged (casualty) share a 2.5 s loop. Casualty root = dragger root + 1.0 m along the dragger facing, casualty heading = dragger heading + 180 deg (head towards the dragger). Contact point = socket drag_handle (Spine1) at (0, 0.50, 0.42) in the casualty frame = (0, 0.50, 0.58) in the dragger frame (both hands).
medical.treat_wounded: medic kneels; the casualty (wounded_ground / wounded_sit) lies ~0.55 m in front of the medic root
medical.wounded_sit: back against a wall plane 0.30 m behind the root (-Z)

soldier_anims.sources: CMU mocap: walk 07_12, run 09_11, crouch walk 136_09, limp 77_19, drag 81_08 (legs), death_back 90_18, throw 113_24. Arms of all rifle clips are IK-solved onto the AK grips (right hand = weapon_socket, left hand = grip_L) then baked. Aim clips: authored cheek-weld head posture, gun on the sight line through the right eye, chest/clavicle solved to bring the butt to the shoulder pocket.

wounded_crawl.notes: belly crawl on the forearms/elbows (arms alternate reach & pull), left leg pushes, right leg dead (foot rolled out) and dragged; no weapon

wounded_ground.notes: on the back, half rolled to the left, right hand pressing a belly wound, left knee drawn up, rocking, head lifting & looking around, left arm reaches up for help (2.4-4.0 s); no weapon (sling it: weapon_socket_back, or drop)

wounded_sit.notes: stabilised casualty sitting on the ground against a wall (wall plane z = -0.3 m behind the root, facing +Z), right leg out with the hand on the dressed thigh, left knee up, head resting back, slow breathing; no weapon

treat_wounded.notes: medic kneeling on the right knee, bent over the casualty, applying a tourniquet (left hand holds the strap, right hand turns the windlass), glances around at 1.6-2.6 s (left) and 4.0-4.9 s (right); work point ~0.5 m in front; rifle slung (weapon_socket_back)

hit_react.notes: authored flinch (impact at 0.05 s), ends in idle stance

death_crumple.notes: reworked: flinch, rifle slips from the hands at ~0.3 s, knees buckle and hit the ground (0.6 s), trunk folds and tips onto the left side, limp arms with head lag; root motion kept; ends at rest

death_front.notes: authored: hit, knees give, pitches forward onto the face (no hands), head turned; root motion kept; ends at rest; drop weapon ~0.2 s

death_back.notes: CMU 90_18 0.35-3.2s, root motion kept, ends at rest; game should drop/detach the weapon at start

throw_grenade.notes: CMU 113_24 overhand throw; right hand is free: attach rifle to weapon_socket_L or weapon_socket_back for the duration; release ~ see manifest

drag_wounded.notes: CMU 81_08 legs (walking backwards), bent over, both hands on the casualty drag handle at [0.0, 0.5, 0.58] (own root frame); casualty root 1.0 m ahead (+Z) playing being_dragged; rifle slung on back; cycle (0, 75)

being_dragged.notes: limp casualty pulled head-first by the vest drag handle (socket drag_handle on Spine1); handle at [-0.0, 0.508, 0.425] in the casualty root frame (head towards +Z); the dragger stands 1.0 m along +Z facing -Z (drag_wounded hands at [0.0, 0.5, 0.58] in its own frame); heels on the ground (ankle min y 0.085); arms trailing; loop matches drag_wounded

ride_sit_deck.notes: sitting on the deck, knees up, rifle held upright between the knees (butt on the deck), ride sway + looking around; seat frame: Hips [0.0, 0.118, -0.035] above/behind the seat point; ik {'R': 1.0448278521973344e-15, 'L': 1.1919557542016666e-15}

throw_grenade_window.notes: overhand lob up into a 1st/2nd-floor window: grenade in the right hand (weapon_socket), rifle in the left (weapon_socket_L); looks up, winds up, steps in with the left foot, releases high in front at 0.86 s (launch ~55 deg up), recovers by 1.5 s

cqb_stack.notes: crouched stack-up beside a doorway (door ahead, +Z), rifle at low ready (muzzle ~35 deg down), weight shifts, glance back at 2.1-2.9 s; ik {'R': 6.591583993652515e-16, 'L': 1.0824674490095276e-15}

deviations: Uniform is part of each body_X SkinnedMesh (head + eyes + uniform); boots are a separate always-on node `boots`; `gloves` is an alternative to `hands`.
Extra nodes beyond the contract: gloves, boots, kneepads, legband_L, pouches_front/side/back split, helmet_B per faction, *_LOD1 for every mesh node.
Extra sockets: weapon_socket_L, mag_socket_L, aim_eye_R. AK-74M magazine is a separate node.
tape_red is not a separate material in the GLB (unused glTF materials are dropped by loaders); recolour `tape` instead (value given above).
throw_grenade needs the rifle moved to weapon_socket_L; wounded/drag/death clips expect the game to drop or sling the rifle.
Full kit (both legbands + kneepads + backpack + pouches_back) slightly exceeds 25k tris; default configuration is listed in default_config_tris.
Assault presets carry ~28-30k tris (armour + 4 extra pouch groups + headset/balaclava); use their _LOD1 (~8k) beyond close range.
GLBs use KHR_mesh_quantization (required) for int8 normals; weights are normalized u8, atlas UVs normalized u16 (all native in three.js GLTFLoader).
